bio.text: Diana Ayala won the Democratic primary for New York State Assembly District 68 on June 23, 2026, and is on the November 3, 2026 ballot on the Democratic and Working Families Party lines.
She served on the New York City Council representing District 8 from January 1, 2018, to January 1, 2026.

Before the Council she was deputy chief of staff to Council Speaker Melissa Mark-Viverito; she earned a degree in human services from Bronx Borough Community College and studied sociology at CUNY Lehman College.
